supporting_observations.claim: The recurring connections in the supplied records are HTTP connections from WS-BCARTER-01 to the internal proxy at 10.30.20.30:8080. The records show a roughly five-minute pattern from 13:30 through 14:06 UTC, although the intervals are not exact.

These periodic connection records do not identify the external HTTPS destination or the process that initiated each connection, so they do not establish whether the traffic was the approved ChartMate updater or another application.

At 14:10 UTC, OneDrive started under ben.carter’s user context, and Chrome made visible requests to SharePoint, including GET requests to SharePoint API paths. The provided records do not establish that files were uploaded or exfiltrated.

The supplied records show routine-looking domain authentication and directory traffic involving the workstation computer account and LSASS, but do not establish that this activity caused the periodic proxy connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: For the periodic events, the listed Zeek records identify the internal proxy as the destination, not the external hostname or URL; corresponding proxy request records identifying those destinations are not present. Relevant examples: T005-00098, T005-00126, T005-00148, T005-00166, T005-00184, T005-00196, T005-00205, T005-00212.

The periodic connection records do not include process attribution. The available process-to-proxy record at 14:10 concerns Chrome and a different connection, not the earlier recurring events. Relevant records: T005-00212, T005-00308, T005-00309.
The supplied records do not include the content or full transfer details needed to determine whether data was uploaded during the observed window.
claims_not_established: Whether the periodic connections went to update.chartmate-imaging.com or were initiated by cmupdate.exe.
Whether the periodic traffic was malicious, or instead an approved updater or other benign activity.
Whether any files or sensitive data were transferred to SharePoint or another external service.
Whether the visible authentication and directory activity was related to the periodic connections.
additional_evidence_needed: Proxy logs for the periodic timestamps, including CONNECT destination, URL where available, action, and byte counts.
Endpoint process-to-network telemetry for WS-BCARTER-01 at each periodic connection time, including process image, command line, parent process, and signature information.
ChartMate installation and updater execution evidence on WS-BCARTER-01, including configured update destination and run history.
File access and upload telemetry for ben.carter’s OneDrive and SharePoint activity around 14:10 UTC.
